text:
maya: heads-up — a few customers hit high recompute lag when late events spiked yesterday, and our backfill jobs basically ate the cluster. needs a short-term quota + longer-term UX change.
sam: can you paste the job ids? want to see priority labels.
maya: job ids: rp-2026-11, rp-2026-12. both were low-priority but concurrent with rolling canary and caused eviction storms.
jordan: re: eviction storms — nodes evicted model kernels and caused higher p99 for hosted. we should avoid full-preempt for backfills.
eva: proposal: fair-share pool for recomputes that caps concurrent worker threads per-team and enforces token throughput limit. low-priority jobs get paused by rate limiter instead of killing.
maya: +1. also add a soft-window: if last_event_ts < now()-6h then backfill can run at reduced priority, otherwise hold.
sam: sketch of quota config I had in mind:
```
backfill.controller:
  concurrency: 30
  token_rate: 10000/s
  per_tenant_share: 0.05
  preempt_strategy: "pause-not-kill"
```
jordan: that looks reasonable. per_tenant_share must be dynamic though — a tenant with many small jobs shouldn't starve one with a big committed enterprise backfill.
eva: we can add priority classes: enterprise > product > ad-hoc. fair-share operates within each class. enterprise gets reserved slots but still below SLO for production traffic.
maya: UX ask: make this visible in console so SEs can see queued backfills and expected start time. current silence leads to Pager duty.
sam: idea: show an estimated start ETA and a "request priority bump" button that creates a support ticket and flags the job for review.
jordan: need an audit log too — who bumped, when, reason. security will want that for Private deployments.
eva: also telemetry: emit these metrics per job: queued_seconds, paused_seconds, resumed_count, effective_token_rate. will help detect starvation.
maya: action items:
- implement rate limiter + pause-not-kill preemption (sam)
- add per-class fair-share allocator (jordan)
- console: queued backfills panel + priority bump flow + audit (maya)
- telemetry events for job lifecycle (eva)
- add canary: run on staging with synthetic late events before enabling (replay-bot)

sam: I'll spin up a draft PR for rate limiter config and link it here.
jordan: add test harness for eviction simulation — I can mock node OOM and ensure pause-not-kill avoids p99 spikes.
eva: for telemetry schema propose naming: "recompute.job.queued_seconds", "recompute.job.paused_seconds", "recompute.job.priority_requested".
maya: thanks team. let's sync in 30m to unblock short-term throttle change. if we don't act, we'll see more customer-facing SLO hits.
replay-bot: scheduled dry-run on staging: 2046124000, injecting 2h late events at 50% traffic. will post results.
sam: ack. I'll start the PR and baseline telemetry dashboards.
maya: closing — I'll update the incident doc with the refractor plan and link PRs after the sync. :thumbsup:"
